text: In 1987 Father Gabriele Amorth, the Pope's scooter-riding exorcist, is sent to a Spanish abbey that a widow and her children have [inherited from her late husband|trigger|making a new home]. Her young son Henry, silent since his father's death, now speaks with [a possessed voice that mocks the priests for their sins|rules|it chooses who dies]. Through a well beneath the abbey Amorth finds [a buried cage the Church sealed and kept quiet|wrong|the powerful abuse their power], and learns that [the demon means to use him to destroy the Church|wants|power over others].
